summary: Daily rotating quote app: rotate deterministically through a fixed list of 50 quotes, showing a new quote each day at a fixed user-provided timezone midnight, with quote list and rotation state persisted.
architectural_notes: Persist quote list and rotation state in the canister so redeploys/updates do not reset the order.
Daily quote selection should be based on a single fixed timezone value provided by the user (not browser local time); compute quote index from current date in that timezone.
known_issues: Quote is still not loading after deploy (needs investigation/fix).

existing_features.title: Update the frontend daily quote feature to use the backend as the quote source and to respect the backend’s fixed-time-zone daily rotation. If the user has not configured a fixed time zone yet, show an inline prompt in the quote area to set it (English text), and do not show “Quote unavailable” due to missing configuration.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement deterministic daily quote rotation through provided list (1→50 loop) with quote-of-the-day changing at midnight in a single fixed user-provided timezone, persisted so rotation continues across redeploys.

Add backend support for a per-user fixed time zone setting that is stored persistently in the canister state (survives canister upgrades/redeploys). The time zone must be representable without relying on server-side IANA/DST rules (e.g., store a fixed UTC offset in minutes or a fixed "UTC±HH:MM" value) and must be retrievable and updatable by the logged-in user.

Implement deterministic quote-of-the-day selection based on the provided static list of 50 quotes, rotating in order (1→50 then loop) and switching at midnight of the user’s saved fixed time zone. The computed daily quote must be stable for the entire day for that user, and must not depend on an external quotes API.

Add an upgrade-safe state migration (only if required by existing deployed state) so that introducing persisted quote/time-zone state does not break existing stored data (e.g., habit tracking state) on upgrade.

projectName: Use a single fixed user-defined time zone for daily quote rotation (persisted)
